Recommendations

Verify PX4 is armed and rocket_mpc module is running — fin commands are near-zero
Range error is -74.1% — tune MPC guidance gains or verify thrust curve
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
Servo tracking MAE=2.09° exceeds 1.5° limit — check fin mechanical play, servo_auto_zero calibration, CAN bus speed
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY to ~0.100s (estimated from tracking P95=5.1° + 40ms overhead). This gives lookahead_stage=5. For precise value: measure cmd→can lag on bench.
